slides.heading: Levent Alpöge Claims AI Helped Solve 19th-Century Math Problem
slides.text: Levent Alpöge, a mathematician at Anthropic, claims AI software Claude helped prove the Riemann hypothesis, a 19th-century unsolved problem in mathematics.

slides.heading: Alpöge's Claim
slides.text: Alpöge, a Turkish American mathematician, claims that Claude, the AI software, helped develop a solution to the Riemann hypothesis during the course of about six weeks.

slides.heading: Verification
slides.text: Two organizations independently verified Alpöge's claim after reviewing the programming language he used to share the solution.
